headline: What to Do When Your New Cabinets Arrive Damaged in Albany
articleBody:
It's a real bummer when you're excited about your new cabinets for your Albany home, and they arrive with dings or dents. This can really throw a wrench in your remodeling timeline! The first, and most crucial, thing to do is inspect your deliveries immediately. Don't just sign off on them without a thorough check. If you find any damage, document it right away with photos and make detailed notes on the delivery receipt. This documentation is super important for any claims or reorders. Next, contact your supplier or contractor as soon as possible to report the issue. They'll guide you on the next steps, which often involve coordinating replacements. Waiting too long can complicate the process, so prompt action is key.
